summary.es: Donovan Rall Syrah es un vino tinto de Rall Winery, con la denominación Wine of Origin Swartland, en Sudáfrica.
summary.en: Donovan Rall Syrah is a red wine from Rall Winery, made under the Wine of Origin Swartland appellation in South Africa.
summary.fr: Donovan Rall Syrah est un vin rouge de Rall Winery, élaboré sous l’appellation Wine of Origin Swartland (Afrique du Sud).
summary.it: Donovan Rall Syrah è un vino rosso di Rall Winery, prodotto nella denominazione Wine of Origin Swartland (Sudafrica).

body.es: Se cría en depósitos de hormigón. Su graduación es de 12,5 % vol.
body.en: It is aged in concrete vats. It has 12.5% ABV.
body.fr: Il est élevé en cuves béton. Il titre 12,5 % vol.
body.it: Affina in vasche di cemento. Ha 12,5% vol.
